module.title: Should we buy a readiness check before reserving freight?
module.description: Compare the feasible backup arrangement now with a registration check followed by a complete operationally eligible response to every possible result. Numerical inputs proposed by a fitted model require an explicit review before evaluation.
module.question: Would a timely registration check improve our shipment choice while leaving a permitted complete response to every possible result?
module.boundary: One bounded shipment, one verification purchase, then one complete direct or backup arrangement. Reserving before a late report is outside this two-stage model.

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Review delivery commitments and shipment arrangements.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.

objective.horizon: This order revision through the Friday receipt commitment

assumptions: Readiness probabilities and report likelihoods are proposed from fictional history by a separately validated model and require explicit reviewer acceptance. The model prediction is not evidence of registration.
Only complete arrangements that pass every mandatory planning check in every logically supported state may be chosen after a report.
A zero probability does not remove a logically admitted situation or waive an operational requirement.
Arrangement payoffs are negative complete quoted expense, excluding the separately charged verification fee. There are no sales revenues or other consequences in this bounded comparison.
A complete planning run at each report-and-response time supplies the eligibility matrix, including expense, cash and separate scoped purchase authority.
The verification fee is deducted once in expected cost and counted once in each branch expense and cash check.
A result received after reservation cannot inform that reservation. A prior reservation followed by a later report needs a different multi-stage policy model.
A hypothetical report never becomes an actual observation or an operating permission.

The authoring reference case is a package-admission example only. Every actual comparison replaces its numerical inputs and planning eligibility with current reviewed inputs and fresh complete SDK planning runs.
